entities.summary: Songhai, a notable figure in the history of Morocco, associated with Saadian and Early Alaouite Dynasties (1554–1659). Preceded by Saadian Dynasty. Their legacy influenced Morocco-US Treaty and Salé Rovers and Barbary Piracy.
